fixture_policy: Isolated bridge/save/replay fixtures. Corrupt checkpoints are deliberately constructed. The queued elite is initialized with damage, upgrades and equipment to test carrying, not to claim a full-night victory. Source battles use the real shared simulator and paid commands; replay executes recorded inputs and exact step deltas.
